era cāracheyā keśavadharao, śubhadattao, nihma kutisa conāverasa, thva chesa conāverasa, coyā biyā juro

date.as_written: saṃvat 962 mti māghaśukla paṃcami reotinakṣatra, śubhayoga, maṅgaravāra

purpose: punyana jana, dhana, guna, jñāna saṃtāna vadhaya juyamāra, ihaloke sukhasaṃpati, pararoke mokṣagati
notes: The commissioner's name in the colophon contains an interlinear/marked addition or deletion: ⌠⌠tyaja śrīnrasiṃ⌡⌡ visamānasinaṃ. 'tyaja' likely represents a scribal cancellation mark for 'śrīnrasiṃ', leaving 'Visamāna' as the intended name; alternatively, it could represent an unassimilated compound name (e.g., Teja Śrīnṛsiṃha Visamāna). Two scribes copied the manuscript together while staying in Kuti: Śubhadattadeva and Keśavadhara.
